source.corpus: 四级真题 7 份（2022-06、2024-06 三套、2025-06 三套，约 596 信息句，社区整理版 txt）
source.register: 科普报道 / 新闻评论 / 书评 / 职场与自助文 / 访谈引语
source.disclosure: 对 原文与参考资料/表达与语法查阅/真题通读：四级篇.md（2026-09-17 旧批 9 条）的不合格返工：按 methodology/什么是句式骨架.md（2026-09-17 定版）重裁旧批并全量重挖。旧批病灶=正则/语法层模式（times what、比较倒装）；本批按「第零问（动作可命名）→骨架死→价值命中（误读侧+产出侧，对真实读者不造假想）→语域→校准」流水直出。例句从 7 份 txt 逐字复制并逐条回原文 sed/grep 核对；社区整理版含 OCR 噪声（词内空格、' 误作 ’、一 误作破折号、双空格），逐字保留并在 notes 标注；行折行以单空格连接（不改字）。不修改 book/ 下任何文件。

calibration: 读者：高考138/六级560/多年不用/考研向/常看美剧，自述长句语法基本懂。因此语法层辨析类误读（倒装语序、虚拟完成式、what 关系代词、as...as 结构）对本读者多为假想——旧批 6 条据此砍。本批主判据为产出侧：读得懂却搭不出（只会用 more and more research shows / I think / it is not surprising 这类平庸版）。课本级（祈使句+and、what...like、just as...so）一律掠过。

verdicts.old_frame: [N] times as [Adj] as [B] / [N] times what [S V]
verdicts.reason: 第零问挂：命名不出交际动作（倍数陈述是比较结构语法层，与 methodology 反例 be more adj. than 同类）。证据句 'output by 2029 is likely to be around 3.5 times what it was when Keynes was writing'（2024-06-1）——本读者读得懂；误读点（what 非疑问词）是语法辨析假想；产出侧可平替（times as much as），价值不命中。

动作可命名（定性取舍：与其说A不如说B），与已编家族A#3 not so much A as B 同族互补且是口语常态形；证据双例 'aging is more a slide into forgetfulness than a journey towards wisdom' / 'It is a behavior we are born with more than one we learn'（2024-06-1）。误读点（抽象名词进槽后找『比较级修饰谁』）真实。注：只收名词/名词短语取舍义，纯形容词比较（more diligent than his brother）是 methodology 明列反例。

verdicts.old_frame: [比较级] than [be/助动词 + 名词主语]（比较从句倒装）
verdicts.reason: 语法结构层，第零问挂（命名出的只是『比较从句倒装』这一语法关系，不是交际动作）。证据句 '…more likely to give abstract descriptions of behaviors than were women'（2024-06-2）——than 后倒装是语法书内容，对本读者误读假想。
课本级：『祈使句+and/or+陈述句表条件』是高中语法考点，对本读者已闭环；语料单例且出自引语（'Care about what other people think and you will always be their prisoner.' 2024-06-1）；产出侧 If you…you will… 平替可接受，退化小。
短语肉判据：linked to/with 是填在谓语槽里的动词+介词搭配，抽走后句子骨架（被动陈述句）还在。证据句 'Diets high in fibre have been linked to a lower risk of…'（2025-06-2）——决定句子怎么搭的不是它。误读点（link≠链接、关联≠因果）是搭配层坑，入本批 phrases。

verdicts.old_frame: [A方 did X], while [B方] would have (preferred/liked) [Y]
verdicts.reason: 组合判据：while 对比已编（03章让步与对照），would have + 过去分词是高中虚拟语气语法层，拆两半各有归属、组合不登记。证据句 'They were complete clock watchers, while I would have liked a more flexible schedule'（2022-06）——would have liked 对高考138读者误读假想（虚拟语气已闭环）。

课本级：what...like 是初中句型，it 形式主语+to V 真主语是高中语法。误读点（like 是介词非『喜欢』）对本读者假想；产出侧 'what it's like to work there' 美剧口语高频，常看美剧的读者已会。证据句 2022-06 'ask your interviewer about what it's like to work for that particular organization'。
第零问可过（自省式设问动作），骨架死度中等（What's something + 定语从句 + but 后共享宾语省略可由语法推导）。卡点在价值命中：误读点（but aren't good at 后空缺）不拦这位读者，产出侧差距中等；双例同篇（2025-06-1）是复现不是独立语境，且语域为口语互动体，考研书面产出用不上。建议不进正式册，挂口语设问族待美剧语料再验。

methodology 判例2 正例直接背书（'there's a need for' 是议论文开场高频预制件）；误读点（for 是逻辑主语标记，N 才是被 V-ed 的主体）真实；证据双例同篇自带复现（2022-06 'there's potential for information to be used incorrectly' / 'there's a need for scientific debates to be perceived as open and true to life'）。With+分词组合出现时按规则拆两半。

frames.frame: if [X] is anything to go by
frames.gloss: 如果X还算数的话（以X为证推断）
frames.notes: 条件句里嵌推断惯用语：拿一个现成迹象给整体判断背书。新闻/评论高频件，句首句中皆可。
frames.pitfall: 读侧硬坑：if…is anything to go by 逐词读成『如果有任何东西可去』整句崩；产出侧只会写 if we judge by X / according to X

examples.text: But some parents object to the new policy if the vigorous debate on the Facebook page of  Anderson County school district is anything to go by.
examples.loc: 真题·四级 2024-06-3 · 阅读 Section B E段（原文 of 后双空格为社区版噪声，逐字保留）

frames.frame: anything but [Adj]
frames.gloss: 绝非…（与字面义相反）
frames.notes: 全盘反预期：anything but 把预期整个掀翻。已编 nothing but（05-patterns）的姊妹条——nothing but=只是，anything but=绝不是，方向相反。
frames.pitfall: 与 nothing but 混淆致方向读反；产出只会写 not at all / not … at all

examples.text: The answers are anything but simple.
examples.loc: 真题·四级 2024-06-2 · 阅读 Section B D段

frames.frame: there are few [N] (that are) more [Adj] (than [X])
frames.gloss: 几乎没有比它更…的（隐性最高级）
frames.notes: 低调夸赞的修辞件：用否定比较级达到最高级断言，比 the most… 优雅收敛。评论/书评标配。
frames.pitfall: 读侧硬坑：few 的否定漏读（读成『有一些』），整句方向读反——实为『它是最…的之一』；产出只会写 the most expressive

examples.text: Fans of classical music can also tell you that there are few types of music that are more expressive.
examples.loc: 真题·四级 2025-06-2 · 阅读 Section C P2

frames.related: 家族A（程度与比较）：隐性最高级

frames.frame: [S] would otherwise [not V] / [S] helps [sb] who would otherwise [not V]
frames.gloss: 若非有此，本会…（反事实补笔）
frames.notes: otherwise 回指『没有前面这件事的平行世界』：一句话补出反事实，不用搭 if there were no… 整个条件句。评估政策/服务价值的高频件。
frames.pitfall: 读侧坑：otherwise 读成转折『否则』去前文找主句，漏掉整个反事实层；产出只会写 if it were not for…

examples.text: Offering online classes certainly helps students who would otherwise not be able to attend classroom sessions.
examples.loc: 真题·四级 2022-06 · 阅读 Section C P1

frames.related: 家族F#1『Were it not for [X]』——反事实族的 otherwise 回指变体

frames.frame: There's no such thing as [X]
frames.gloss: 根本没有…这回事（否认X的存在）
frames.notes: 整类否认件：断言某事物作为类别不存在，比 X doesn't exist 语气重、话题性强。评论开场/抬杠皆高频。
frames.pitfall: 产出退化：只会写 a private debate doesn't exist / there is no private debate；no such thing as 的斩钉截铁语气出不来

examples.text: In the age of the internet, there's no such thing as a private debate.
examples.loc: 真题·四级 2022-06 · 阅读 Section C P2

frames.frame: Gone are the days of/when [X]
frames.gloss: …的时代一去不返
frames.notes: 倒装宣告件： Gone 提前+are the days，宣告旧时代结束，常接 and that's good/bad because… 评注。
frames.pitfall: 读侧坑：倒装读慢，主语（the days of…）在 are 后面找不到；产出只会写 the days of X are gone（平铺版）

examples.text: Gone are the days of going to a conference and debating scientific issues, and that's good because those gatherings were not diverse enough and excluded many important voices.
examples.loc: 真题·四级 2022-06 · 阅读 Section C P2

frames.frame: It's not that [X]. It's that [Y]
frames.gloss: 不是X的问题，而是Y（纠正归因）
frames.notes: 两段式归因纠偏：先否定显性解释，再亮真因。口语书面都高频，引语/评论/日常解释皆用。
frames.pitfall: 读侧弱坑：It's not that 拆成『它不是』找先行词；产出侧强坑：只会写 The reason is not X but Y（书面腔，丢掉口语节奏）

examples.text: That’s why brain scientist Richard Kennedy says “It’s not that old dogs can't learn new tricks. It's that maybe old dogs don't realize why they should.”
examples.loc: 真题·四级 2024-06-1 · 阅读 Section C P2（引语内混用直/弯引号，逐字保留）

frames.related: 六级篇#14『[否定前句]; rather, [S V]』同功能（纠正归因）异形

frames.frame: You might think (of) [X], but [Y]；变体：Well you'd expect [X], but [Y]
frames.gloss: 你可能会以为X——但其实是Y（预判预期再推翻）
frames.notes: 设靶家族的预判版：先替读者说出他心里的话，再掀翻。科普/评论开篇高频；you'd expect 版更口语。
frames.pitfall: 读侧：might think 的『替你预设』语用漏读，只当普通陈述；产出侧强坑：设靶只会写 Some people think… / It is said that…（第三人称版，丢掉直接对话感）

examples.text: You might think of your teeth as tools, like built-in knives and forks, but if they are mere tools, why do they feel pain
examples.loc: 真题·四级 2022-06 · 阅读 Section A（选词填空篇，引文截至空格编号前）

examples.text: Well you ’d expect the Design Museum to commission and make some interesting items,  but this one was different.
examples.loc: 真题·四级 2025-06-1 · 阅读 Section B D段（you ’d/双空格为社区版噪声，逐字保留）

frames.related: 设靶家族：cam14『We are told that [S V]』被动规训版、判例库设问版『But is there a cost to X?』——本条为预判读者版

frames.frame: It may sound [Adj], but [Y]
frames.gloss: 听上去也许X——但（让步预驳）
frames.notes: 先承认自己话 听感 上像老生常谈/惊人，再站住立场。自我设靶+自我辩护一步完成，语料双例独立语境。
frames.pitfall: 读侧：may sound 的『预判你反应』漏读；产出侧强坑：只会写 Although it sounds surprising…（让步从句平铺版）

examples.text: It may sound surprising, but you don't have to be interested in fashion, or even in history, to enjoy Dress Codes: How the Laws of Fashion Made History.
examples.loc: 真题·四级 2024-06-3 · 阅读 Section C P1

examples.text: It may sound trite (老生常谈的), but beauty is only skin deep
examples.loc: 真题·四级 2025-06-3 · 阅读 Section C P1（社区版夹注中文释义，逐字保留）

frames.frame: [X] is, at best, [Adj]
frames.gloss: 往高了说也才X（贬抑性让步）
frames.notes: 评注式贬抑：at best 插在系动词和表语间，承认最优解读也不过如此。驳论/书评利器。
frames.pitfall: 读侧坑：at best 读成中性『最好情况下』，漏掉整句的贬损语气；产出只会写 is not good enough / is far from sufficient（丢掉让步壳）

examples.text: “This argument is, at best, far from sufficient,” he writes.
examples.loc: 真题·四级 2024-06-1 · 阅读 Section B D段

frames.related: 家族D#2 admittedly/granted（先让后转）——at best 为贬抑版

frames.frame: If that were the case, [why did…? / S V]
frames.gloss: 倘若果真如此，那…（归谬反问）
frames.notes: 回指式虚拟条件：that 指对方刚立的说法，用虚拟 were 标记『我并不认账』，后接反问或推论归谬。
frames.pitfall: 读侧坑：were 读成过去时误以为说话人认了前提；产出只会写 If it is true…（陈述条件，丢掉不认账的虚拟语气）

examples.text: If that were the case, why did the duration of the working week decline in the first place?
examples.loc: 真题·四级 2024-06-1 · 阅读 Section B D段

frames.related: 家族F（条件与虚拟）：回指虚拟条件

frames.frame: It should come as no surprise (to sb) that [S V]
frames.gloss: …不足为奇（顺理成章连接）
frames.notes: 承上启下的必然性件：前文摆了证据，本句宣布结论是自然结果。学术/评论高频。
frames.pitfall: 读侧坑：come as 卡住（『作为…而来』拆不开）；产出只会写 it is not surprising that…

examples.text: So, it should come as no surprise to anyone that classical music pieces are still used as background music in modern movies.
examples.loc: 真题·四级 2025-06-2 · 阅读 Section C P2

frames.frame: there may be a grain of truth in [X]
frames.gloss: X里也许有几分道理（部分承认）
frames.notes: 驳论文先让步件：对老话/流行说法部分放行（一粒真），下文再收紧。比 partly true 地道且有分寸感。
frames.pitfall: 读侧坑：a grain of truth 字面『一粒真理』读不懂；产出只会写 there is some truth in it（丢掉 grain 的分寸修辞）

examples.text: Most people don’t really believe in them, but research into the impact of clothes on behavior now suggests that there may actually be a gra in of truth in these sayings.
examples.loc: 真题·四级 2025-06-2 · 阅读 Section C P1（gra in 词内空格为社区版噪声，逐字保留）

frames.related: cam14『[V-ing] is nothing new』——同为『消解/部分承认』族

frames.frame: While we know [X], we don't yet know [Y] / it's less clear [wh-Y]
frames.gloss: 我们已知X，但尚不清楚Y（研究缺口划界）
frames.notes: 科普/学术划界件：while 让步挂已知，主句亮未知，一句完成文献综述的边界声明。考研写作可直接用。
frames.pitfall: 读侧：while 让步误读为时间『当…时』；it's less clear 读成作者自谦『我不太清楚』（实为学界边界）；产出只会写 But we don't know…

examples.text: So while we know that fruit juice can cause diabetes if it’s part of a diet that has more calories overall, it's less clear how juice affects the long-term health of those who aren’t overweight.
examples.loc: 真题·四级 2025-06-2 · 阅读 Section B G段（混用直/弯撇号，逐字保留）

examples.text: While we know that adults use a large variety of attributes to manage and create impressions, we don’t yet know whether children
examples.loc: 真题·四级 2025-06-1 · 阅读 Section A（选词填空篇，引文截至空格编号前，后接 whether 从句）

frames.frame: this is not the case with [X]
frames.gloss: （前述对A成立，）但X不是这么回事（划界排除）
frames.notes: 边界标记件：先让前文概括成立，再用本句把例外圈出来。语料两例独立语境。
frames.pitfall: 读侧：case 读成『案例/情况』拆散；产出只会写 but fruit juice is different（丢掉回指结构）

examples.text: But this is not the case with fruit juice.
examples.loc: 真题·四级 2025-06-2 · 阅读 Section B C段

examples.text: Although Keynes’s eight-fold figure holds up for the economy as a whole, it is not at all the case for the median(中位数的) American worker.
examples.loc: 真题·四级 2024-06-1 · 阅读 Section B G段（夹注中文释义，逐字保留）

frames.frame: By all means [V], but [Y]；同族：There's nothing wrong with [V-ing/N], but [Y]
frames.gloss: 尽管去X——但是Y（先放行再设限）
frames.notes: 许可-转折双段件：先把对方想做的事大方放行，再用 but 收口给真条件。口语书面都高频，建议文/劝导文标配。
frames.pitfall: 读侧硬坑：By all means 读成『用一切办法』的强化义（实为让步『尽管去』）；产出只会写 You can…, but…（丢掉让步放行的姿态）

examples.text: By all means,  set ambitious long-term goals for your future  self, but when it comes to actually following through day-to-day, make sure your present self knows what's in it for her too.
examples.loc: 真题·四级 2024-06-2 · 阅读 Section B M段（双空格为社区版噪声，逐字保留）

examples.text: There’s nothing wrong with trying to look our best but excessive focus on physical appearance misses the soulful aspects of what it means to be beautiful.
examples.loc: 真题·四级 2025-06-3 · 阅读 Section C P1

frames.related: 家族D#2 admittedly/granted（先让后转）——口语放行版

frames.frame: Who says [X]? / I mean, who [V]s [X]?
frames.gloss: 谁说X了？／谁会想X啊？（修辞反问挑战）
frames.notes: 反问否定族：答案显然是否，问句本身即立场。Who says… 挑战默认假设；I mean, who… 收尾吐槽。美剧与评论双高频。
frames.pitfall: 读侧：语用漏读成真实疑问句，等下文找答案；产出只会写 I don't think X is necessarily bad

examples.text: Who says instant gratification has to be a bad thing ?

examples.loc: 真题·四级 2025-06-2 · 阅读 Section C P1

frames.related: internal-batch-001『Who would have thought (that) [X]?』——同为反问，功能相反（惊叹 vs 挑战），分立

frames.frame: It pays to [V]
frames.gloss: （这样做）是划算的/有回报的
frames.notes: 划算性建议件：pay 挂回报义，比 it is worthwhile 紧凑。建议文/生活科普高频。
frames.pitfall: 读侧坑：pay 读成『支付』字面义卡住；产出只会写 it is worth doing / you should

examples.text: Meanwhile, it pays to examine studies funded by industry or special interest groups with extra care.
examples.loc: 真题·四级 2024-06-2 · 阅读 Section C P2

frames.frame: A little [X] can go a long way (towards [V-ing])
frames.gloss: 小小一点X作用很大
frames.notes: 小投入大回报强调件：a little 与 go a long way 形成反差对仗，建议文收尾金句。
frames.pitfall: 读侧坑：go a long way 读成字面『走很远』；产出只会写 small efforts are also useful

examples.text: A little examination can go a long way towards identifying bias associated with the funding source.

frames.frame: [Adj] enough to [V], but not so [Adj] that [S V]
frames.gloss: 要…到能X的程度，但别…到Y的地步（最优区间定界）
frames.notes: Goldilocks 定界件：双向定量，一句话给出上下限。语料原文自带命名（so-called Goldilocks principle: there can be just the right amount of something）。考研写作『既要又要但不过度』刚需。
frames.pitfall: 产出侧强坑：两个方向的对仗搭不出，只会写 should be X but not too X；读侧：not so…that 的否定范围易读漏

examples.text: The experts concluded that pandas should ideally “be happy enough to thrive, but not so content that they don’t want to move around and find new mates”.
examples.loc: 真题·四级 2025-06-1 · 阅读 Section C P1（引语）

frames.frame: as much of a [A] as a [B]
frames.gloss: 既是A也同样是B（双刃定性，不遑多让）

granularity_note: 本批最长收录：'By all means,  set ambitious long-term goals for your future  self, but when it comes to actually following through day-to-day, make sure your present self knows what's in it for her too.'——判组合切分：只收 By all means…but 放行-收口框架，后半 when it comes to（已编）+ make sure（开放句型）不收。最长落选链：'the possible reason for this may partly have been the lack of the other components found in whole fruit'（2025-06-2）与 'Friedman tries to figure out why…has not translated into…'——多层名词化+宾语从句链，死词密度低，判长难句素材不收。碎片收整例：'What are my chances…? Slim to none' 与 'His aim? To isolate…' 以问句+碎片答整句视角收进自问自答条，两例独立语境。旧批重裁后仅 2 过 1 存疑，砍掉的 6 条全部撞『语法层/课本级/组合/短语肉/误读假想』五不收判据——正则能找到的（times what、than were 倒装）恰是本读者最不需要的。
